methods.label: Complete and compare the angle triples
methods.explanation: In option D, \(\angle C=180^\circ-40^\circ-70^\circ=70^\circ=\angle B\), so the triangle is isosceles. In A, the angles are \(30^\circ,50^\circ,100^\circ\); in B, \(50^\circ,60^\circ,70^\circ\); and in C, \(20^\circ,60^\circ,100^\circ\). Each of those triples has three unequal angles. Thus D is correct.
methods.levelReason: The triangle angle sum and both directions of the equal-side/equal-angle relationship are standard Grade 8 material.
